description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the OrderTypeValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation rules for OrderType objects.

classes.name: OrderTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the OrderTypeValidator in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheOrderTypeObjectIsNull
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws IllegalArgumentException if the OrderType object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks validation failure when the OrderType's name is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks validation failure when the OrderType's name is an empty string.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsWhitespace
methods.description: Checks validation failure when the OrderType's name is whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsWhiteSpace
methods.description: Duplicate of above, checks whitespace name validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsADuplicate
methods.description: Checks validation failure if the OrderType's name duplicates an existing order type.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptClassIsADuplicate
methods.description: Checks validation fails if concept classes are duplicated in the OrderType.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfParentIsAmongItsDescendants
methods.description: Tests that setting a parent as a descendant correctly triggers validation error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfParentIsAlsoADirectChild
methods.description: Tests that setting a direct child as parent triggers validation error.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllFieldsAreCorrectForANewOrderType
methods.description: Validates that a well-formed new OrderType passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllFieldsAreCorrectForAnExistingOrderType
methods.description: Validates that an existing order type passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeInvokedWhenAnOrderTypeIsSaved
methods.description: Ensures validation is invoked during saving and fails validation with appropriate message.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that fields with acceptable lengths pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that excessively long field values trigger length validation errors.
